Changelog

MTDI's version moves when a pillar's behaviour changes. Projects are listed when they are integrated.

5.0.0 — MTDI Studio

First release of MTDI as a studio: every pillar implemented and working together, for any hardware, firmware or software, driven by one manifest per project.

  • 00 Validation Chamber: presence, freshness, achieved vs expected rate, timing regularity, clipping against a declared raw range, dropped-line counting, LOD = 3σ and LOQ = 10σ from measured noise.
  • 01 Environmental Intelligence: Inductra's Baseline Lock and Transient Watch made sensor-agnostic. Per-axis baselines and axial consensus for any vector sensor, a stale-lock watch, learn/lock/unlock, and named environments saved from real data only, then recalled to compare against.
  • Core: Inductra's 8-factor weighted score with per-project weights, cross-channel correlation, completeness, and optional channels.
  • 02 NVTRA: universal interpretation rules, project domain rules as data, and grounded answers from the live packet, with a hook for a language model.
  • 03 I³: the interface framework extracted from Inductra Vaion, now a pillar, with live traces, live sentences and action buttons. Every page is generated from the manifest.
  • 04 Aether: purpose and authorship per project, non-functional.
  • Protocol: KEY=value / JSON lines, strict; Inductra's firmware format unchanged.
  • Adapters: serial (USB, socket://, rfc2217://), TCP listen/connect, HTTP ingest, Python generator, process (any program in any language), system (host telemetry, standard library on Linux), replay, and a SIMULATED simulator; plus a recorder.
  • Any field: a channel's domain is an open word (sensors, compute, network, security, …).
  • Small boards: run --headless (JSON API, no Dash) and watch (terminal view over SSH).
  • AI-operable: llms.txt, docs/AI.md playbook, AGENTS.md, a JSON Schema for manifests, python -m mtdi describe, and python -m mtdi adopt to build another repository on MTDI.
  • Integrations: python -m mtdi create wizard and publish: GitHub repository, Vercel deployment, Notion page, MATLAB Online starter. Tokens from the environment only.
  • Two implementations: matlab/+mtdi independently recomputes python -m mtdi analyze; verified to agree in GNU Octave by the test suite.
  • Website: python -m mtdi site build renders the docs, articles and a replay of the real engine for every example project with the same I³ components (mtdi/pillars/i3/static.py).
  • Placeholders: templates use only Title, Subtext, Text, Label and Value.

Projects

  • inductra-vaion (project 1): magnetic and electric channels from Inductra's own Uno firmware and Mac bridge (byte-identical copies), RF as an optional HTTP source, Inductra's three signature rules as NVTRA rules.
  • ultrasonic-room (example): HC-SR04 echo distance, the first non-electromagnetic project.
  • host-health (example): the computer MTDI runs on, real telemetry with no wiring.
  • network-watch (example): TCP connect latency and failures from a plain-Python probe.
  • auth-watch (example): failed and accepted logins per window from a Linux auth log.
